test_title: PYST 35: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The guard did not want anything bad to happen, so he ordered the group to step back to avoid anything ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"terrible"** means extremely bad or serious. (बहुत बुरा या गंभीर)

 
 
• **Example:** The earthquake caused terrible destruction in the city.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word **'terrible'** is** appropriate in the context to describe something bad that the guard wants to avoid. **(बहुत बुरा या गंभीर)
 
 
• **Example:** The guard did not want anything bad to happen, so he ordered the group to step back to avoid anything **terrible.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is:*** 'terrible'.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Habitual** (आदतन): Done regularly or repeatedly, often without thinking.

 
 
• **Example:** His habitual tardiness is starting to annoy his colleagues.
 
 
 
• **Diplomatic** (राजनयिक): Involving diplomacy or diplomats; tactful.
 
 
• **Example:** She was very diplomatic in her response to avoid offending anyone.
 
 
 
• **Customary** (प्रथागत): According to the customs or usual practices associated with a particular society, place, or set of circumstances.
 
 
• **Example:** It is customary to shake hands when meeting someone for the first time.
 
 

39:Tcc2,

The correct answer is **Option 1)**
